definitions.N: Number of nodes in the nonempty owned tree.
definitions.R: Sum of strict descendants below each managed node.
definitions.C: Sum of immediate children below each managed node.

derivation: Base disposal visits N nodes and N - 1 child edges.
A managed node runs one unregister walk. Those walks enter R descendants.
Walk edges contribute C visits; recursive release edges contribute R - C visits. Their 14-instruction terms sum to 14R.
There are N + M managed-predicate calls. Each checked predicate costs two instructions.
Both hooks run for each release visit. Use the per-slot maximum from all 33 checked receiver classes.
The new false tracking tail costs three instructions per node.
R is at most N times D. A separate entry guard can enforce M at most one, which implies R at most N - 1.
exclusions: Disposal wrappers and their delegates, HashMap and listener bodies.
Owned collection bodies and JDK iterator bodies.
Class initialization, native execution, concurrent mutation, and failure latency.
No N, M, D, map capacity, or listener limit is admitted by this report.
